summary.zh-CN: 现在可以把 Rust 编写的 Service App 编译为可移植的 WebAssembly Component，并在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上由 NextClaw 统一运行。
summary.en-US: Build Rust Service Apps as portable WebAssembly Components and run them through NextClaw on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

title.zh-CN: 跨平台运行的 Service App

body.zh-CN: Service App 可以把 Rust 逻辑编译为 WebAssembly Component，由 NextClaw 随产品提供的运行器加载，不需要在每台机器单独准备开发者运行环境。
body.en-US: A Service App can compile Rust logic into a WebAssembly Component that runs in the runner shipped with NextClaw, without preparing a developer runtime on every machine.

title.zh-CN: 可体验的日常小工具箱

body.zh-CN: 内置示例包含今日清单、灵感便签、专注小钟和联系人整理，用来体验数据保存、后台常驻事件、模块之间协作、面板授权和 Agent 调用应用能力。
body.en-US: The included examples cover a daily list, quick notes, a focus timer, and contact organizing, demonstrating saved data, resident background events, module collaboration, panel permissions, and Agent access to app capabilities.

title.zh-CN: 统一的应用开发与恢复链路
title.en-US: A unified app development and recovery path

body.zh-CN: 使用 nextclaw app check、dev 和 call 可以检查、调试和调用可移植 Service App；运行器超时或退出后，持久组件会按依赖关系恢复，已有数据会保留。
body.en-US: Use nextclaw app check, dev, and call to validate, debug, and invoke Portable Service Apps. Persistent components recover in dependency order after a runner timeout or exit, while their existing data is retained.
